Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Pod `payments-5bc47dccd9-qblwz` in namespace `shop` is Running but not Ready because its readiness probe (`nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local`) times out, since the `deny-all` NetworkPolicy in `shop` denies all egress, DNS included.
EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop networkpolicies -o yaml`: `deny-all` has `podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]` and no egress rules, so every pod in `shop` loses egress, including DNS to kube-dns.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod payments-5bc47dccd9-qblwz`: `Ready: False`, `ContainersReady: False`, `Restart Count: 0`, `Status: Running`, readiness `exec [nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local] delay=0s timeout=5s period=10s #success=1 #failure=2`.
- Same describe, events: `Warning Unhealthy (x16 over 2m23s) ... Readiness probe failed: command timed out: "nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local" timed out after 5s`.
- diag-k8s reported the same chain from its own describe and networkpolicy reads (task task-fdf2de63c8a1f6d4ceffdc78); I did not re-check its event counts.
FIX (not applied): Add an egress rule to the `deny-all` NetworkPolicy in `shop` (or a companion policy) allowing UDP and TCP port 53 to kube-dns in `kube-system`, so the readiness probe's DNS lookup can succeed.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: NetworkPolicy `deny-all` (`podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]`, no egress rule) blocks DNS, 53/UDP to kube-dns

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: allow egress to kube-dns on 53/UDP and 53/TCP, or remove `deny-all`
